The Utah Jazz host the Orlando Magic in their 12th game of the 2026-27 season, with Utah at 1-10 (1-5 at home), 15th in the West and 5th in the Northwest, 7.5 games back, on a nine-game losing streak. Orlando is 3-7 (3-3 on the road), 11th in the East, and riding a one-game winning streak.

Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), Keyonte George (ankle sprain), and Lauri Markkanen (wrist sprain), while Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), and Tristan da Silva (calf strain).

The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Jazz lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 120-117 in Orlando on February 7, 2026.
